description: This file defines a Java interface named 'FilePut' within the package 'com.salesmanager.core.modules.cms.content'. The interface declares methods for adding a single file or multiple files, both associated with a merchant store identified by 'merchantStoreCode'. It utilizes the 'InputContentFile' model and can throw 'ServiceException'.

classes.name: FilePut
classes.description: A Java interface for content file upload operations, allowing adding individual or multiple files for a merchant store, with exception handling.

methods.name: addFile
methods.description: Adds a single content file for a specified merchant store; may throw a ServiceException.

methods.name: addFiles
methods.description: Adds multiple content files for a specified merchant store; may throw a ServiceException.
